company.name: Sola
company.shortDescription: Sola is a natural disaster insurance company that offers data-driven property insurance policies.
company.description: Sola is a natural disaster insurance company that offers data-driven property insurance policies. It develops a data-driven insurance platform to offer coverage for wind, hail, and tornado-related property damage. It also offers real-time weather detection, automatic outreach, and same-day payouts.

productsAndServices.description: A standalone residential insurance policy that provides payouts for covered wind, hail, and tornado damage, including high deductibles and roof depreciation gaps left by homeowners insurance.
productsAndServices.name: Sola Wind and Hail Insurance

productsAndServices.description: A claims service for submitting and tracking wind, hail, and tornado claims, using weather data and photo documentation to assess covered events and issue payouts.
productsAndServices.name: Sola Claims Administration

productsAndServices.description: A distribution and support program that enables independent insurance agents to quote and sell Sola standalone wind and hail policies alongside homeowners insurance.
productsAndServices.name: Independent Agent Partner Program

productsAndServices.description: An API-based service for mortgage lenders and servicers to quote Sola coverage for borrowers and connect policy, loan, and claims workflows to existing systems.
productsAndServices.name: Mortgage Lender API Quoting and Integration

productsAndServices.description: An online portal for Sola policyholders to make payments, access policy documents, submit or track claims, and manage policy-related information.
productsAndServices.name: Member Policy Self-Service Portal

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $8,000,433, or 68.38% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,902,362 to $46,994,284, a 6.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
